title: Automation Product Pack — Frontend product editor, generator, previews, export & sync UI

requirements.summary: Build an editor workflow to manage exactly three digital product entries with local draft persistence and regeneration triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit exactly three product entries in the UI (with clear labels and validation).
Edits persist across page refresh (local persistence is acceptable).
User can trigger generation for an individual product or for all three products.

file_operations.description: Define the frontend ProductEntry shape supporting title, subtitle, description, modules/chapters, prompts/templates/checklists, optional branding fields, and generation state for exactly three products.
Implement local draft persistence (load/save/reset) for exactly three ProductEntry records using localStorage, including basic validation and versioning for safe upgrades.

Create the product editor UI for a single ProductEntry using shadcn-ui composition (e.g., Card/Input/Textarea/Tabs/Badge/Button) with clear labels and inline validation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a workspace container that renders exactly three labeled product editors, provides per-product and global 'Regenerate' actions, and coordinates loading/saving drafts via localDrafts.

Create the main app shell wiring the workspace into the UI, including navigation between 'Editor' and 'Export' screens (no orphan views). Use shadcn-ui layout primitives as available; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Generate per-product downloadable PDF and ZIP (PDF + supplementary files) fully in-browser with deterministic safe filenames.
acceptanceCriteria: For each product, the app produces a downloadable PDF file generated from the product’s current content.
For each product, the app produces a downloadable ZIP containing the PDF plus supplementary files in a clear folder structure.
Generated filenames are deterministic and safe (no illegal characters), and include product name + version/date.
All downloads work in a standard modern browser without requiring external services.

file_operations.description: Add/confirm client-side generation dependencies (PDF generation + ZIP packaging + file download helpers) so PDF and ZIP downloads work fully in-browser without external services.
Implement deterministic, safe filename generation (slugify + date/version tag) for PDFs, product ZIPs, and the all-products ZIP.
Implement in-browser multi-page PDF generation for a ProductEntry, including cover image embedding and basic layout/typography.

Build a structured ZIP per product containing the generated PDF plus supplementary files (TXT/MD templates, checklists, prompt packs) in a clear folder structure, and include the product cover image file.
Provide download helpers to trigger browser downloads for generated Blob/File objects (PDF and ZIP) with the deterministic safe filenames.
Create orchestration to generate (a) PDF, (b) ZIP, and (c) generation metadata for one product on demand, updating in-memory state for previews/export.
Create orchestration to generate bundles for all three products in sequence/parallel with progress reporting hooks.

requirements.summary: Create a Gumroad/Etsy export screen listing generated deliverables with sizes, timestamps, thumbnails, and one-click downloads including an all-products ZIP.
acceptanceCriteria: Export screen lists three products with: included files list, last-generated timestamp, and download buttons.
User can download an all-products bundle as a single ZIP.
If a product has not been generated yet, the UI clearly indicates this and disables downloads until generation is run.

file_operations.description: Implement the export screen UI: list three products, show deliverables summary (file list, sizes, last-generated time), cover thumbnail, per-product download buttons, and a 'Download all products' action. Use shadcn-ui components (Card/Table/Button/Badge) via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement creation of a single all-products ZIP containing the three per-product ZIPs with a clear top-level folder structure and deterministic naming.
Wire the ExportScreen into the app navigation and ensure export state is shared with the editor/generation workflow (no orphan route/screen).

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity login UX and frontend sync mode to save/reload the three product definitions and generation metadata from the backend while keeping a local-only mode for guests.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can save and reload their three product definitions from the backend.
Backend enforces that each user only accesses their own product data.
App continues to function in a limited mode when not authenticated (e.g., local-only drafts), with a clear prompt to sign in to sync.

file_operations.description: Add a Login/Logout button using the authorization component’s Internet Identity guidance (useInternetIdentity + cache clearing via react-query). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a react-query hook to load the current user profile via actor.getCallerUserProfile with correct loading gating to avoid modal flash (per authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement first-login profile setup (ask for name, save via actor.saveCallerUserProfile), and show the saved name in the UI instead of a principal id. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Form controls via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement authenticated sync helpers to save/reload the three ProductEntry records and generation metadata through the existing backend interface methods (serialize the full product entry into backend-safe fields as needed), and gracefully handle authorization errors.
Create a hook that exposes 'Sync to cloud' and 'Load from cloud' actions, auto-loads on login when available, and keeps local-only drafts when logged out, with a clear UI status.

Wire authentication UI (LoginButton + ProfileSetupDialog) into the app shell, show a clear prompt to sign in for multi-device sync, and ensure local-only mode remains usable when not authenticated. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent Tailwind-based visual theme across editor, preview, and export screens with English-only UI text and no changes to immutable UI component sources.
acceptanceCriteria: UI has a consistent look and feel across editor, preview, and export screens.
No user-facing strings appear in languages other than English.
Theme avoids default/unstyled appearance and uses Tailwind + existing UI components via composition (no edits to immutable UI component sources).

file_operations.description: Add global theme styling (CSS variables aligned with Tailwind/shadcn patterns, base typography, background, spacing defaults) to ensure a distinctive 'digital product generator' look.

Create a shared layout wrapper (header, content container, consistent spacing) used by editor and export screens. Use shadcn-ui components via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Apply AppLayout usage and normalize all user-facing strings to English across navigation, buttons, empty states, and error messages.

requirements.summary: Add in-app previews for generated PDFs (quick preview) and ZIP contents (file tree/list) that update after regeneration.
acceptanceCriteria: User can preview key sections/pages before download for each product.
User can view the list of files/folders that will be included in each ZIP prior to generation/download.
Preview updates after regeneration.

file_operations.description: Implement an in-app PDF preview panel for a product (e.g., first pages rendered or embedded preview from a generated Blob URL) that refreshes after regeneration.
Implement a ZIP contents preview (tree/list) showing the folder/file structure that will be included, based on current ProductEntry + generation rules (works pre-download).

Wire PdfPreviewPanel and ZipContentsPreview into the editor workflow so previews are visible prior to download and update after regeneration. Use shadcn-ui Tabs/Accordion as appropriate via composition; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add preview affordances on the export screen (thumbnail + quick preview access) and ensure previews reflect the last-generated artifacts.

requirements.summary: Include three static generated cover images as UI thumbnails and as files inside each product’s downloadable ZIP bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Each product includes a cover image file in its ZIP bundle.
Export screen shows a thumbnail preview for each product cover image.
Cover images are served as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated (not through the backend).

file_operations.description: Add generated static cover image asset at exactly this path for product 1 and reference it from the UI and bundle builder.
Add generated static cover image asset at exactly this path for product 2 and reference it from the UI and bundle builder.
Add generated static cover image asset at exactly this path for product 3 and reference it from the UI and bundle builder.
Centralize mapping of the three products to their static cover image asset paths for consistent UI thumbnail rendering and ZIP inclusion.
Ensure the product ZIP bundle includes the correct cover image file from frontend/public/assets/generated (and that ZIP contents preview reflects it).
Render the cover image thumbnails for each product using the static asset mappings (no backend image serving).
